1 --- 2 name: infographic-creator 3 description: 基于给定文字内容创建精美信息图。当用户请求创建信息图时使用。 4 --- 5 6 信息图（Infographic）将数据、信息与知识转化为可感知的视觉语言。它结合视觉设计与数据可视化，用直观符号压缩复杂信息，帮助受众快速理解并记住要点。 7 8 `Infographic = Information Structure + Visual Expression` 9 10 本任务使用 [AntV Infographic](https://infographic.antv.vision/) 创建可视化信息图。 11 12 在开始任务前，需要理解 AntV Infographic 语法规范，包括模板列表、数据结构、主题等。 13 14 ## 规范 15 16 ### AntV Infographic 语法 17 18 AntV Infographic 语法是一种自定义 DSL，用于描述信息图渲染配置。它使用缩进表达结构，适合 AI 直接生成并流式输出。核心信息包括： 19 20 1. template：用模板表达信息结构。 21 2. data：信息图数据，包含 `title`、`desc` 和主数据字段。 22 3. theme：主题配置，包含 `palette`、字体、风格化等。 23 24 例如： 25 26 ```infographic 27 infographic list-row-horizontal-icon-arrow 28 data 29 title Title 30 desc Description 31 lists 32 - label Label 33 value 12.5 34 desc Explanation 35 icon document text 36 theme 37 palette #3b82f6 #8b5cf6 #f97316 38 ``` 39 40 ### 硬性语法规则 41 42 - 第一行必须是 `infographic `。 43 - 模板列表里只写模板名本身；真正输出时首行必须显式写出 `infographic` 前缀。 44 - 使用 `data` / `theme` 块，块内统一使用两个空格缩进。 45 - 键值对写法是 `键 空格 值`；对象数组使用 `-` 作为条目前缀。 46 - `icon` 使用图标关键词，例如 `star fill`、`mingcute/server-line`。 47 - `value` 尽量使用纯数值；数值单位优先放在 `label` 或 `desc` 中表达。 48 - `palette` 推荐使用行内简单数组写法，例如 `palette #4f46e5 #06b6d4 #10b981`。 49 - `palette` 中的颜色值是裸值，不加引号，不加逗号。 50 - `data` 只放一个与模板匹配的主数据字段，避免同时混用 `lists`、`sequences`、`compares`、`values`、`root`、`nodes`。 51 52 主数据字段选择规则： 53 54 - `list-*` → `lists` 55 - `sequence-*` → `sequences`，可选 `order asc|desc` 56 - `sequence-interaction-*` → `sequences` + `relations` 57 - `sequences` 表示泳道列表 58 - 每个泳道必须包含 `label` 59 - 每个泳道的 `children` 表示节点列表 60 - `children` 下的每一项都必须写成对象条目，并包含 `label` 61 - 节点可选 `id`、`icon`、`step`、`desc`、`value` 62 - `step` 用于表示时间层级；相同 `step` 处于同一高度 63 - `compare-*` → `compares` 64 - `compare-binary-*` / `compare-hierarchy-left-right-*` 65 - `compares` 第一层必须且只能有两个根节点，分别表示对比双方 66 - 两个根节点都应包含 `children` 67 - 真正的对比项写在各自的 `children` 下 68 - `children` 下的每一项都必须写成对象条目，并包含 `label` 69 - 即使每一侧只有 1 个指标，也要写成 `children` 内含 1 个对象条目 70 - `compare-swot` 71 - `compares` 可直接放多个根节点 72 - 每个根节点下可选 `children` 73 - `compare-quadrant-*` 74 - `compares` 直接放 4 个象限根节点 75 - `hierarchy-structure` → `items` 76 - `hierarchy-*` → 单一 `root`，通过 `children` 递归嵌套 77 - `relation-*` → `nodes` + `relations` 78 - 简单关系也可直接用箭头语法表达关系 79 - `chart-*` → `values` 80 - `chart-line-plain-text` / `chart-bar-plain-text` / `chart-column-simple` 都使用单条有序 `values` 81 - 每个数据点使用 `label` 表示类目，使用 `value` 表示数值 82 - 折线图的顺序由 `values` 中条目的排列顺序表达 83 - 结构无法明确判断时，再用 `items` 兜底 84 85 主题规则： 86 87 - `theme` 用于自定义主题，例如 `palette`、`base`、`stylize` 88 - 使用 `theme.base.text.font-family` 指定字体，如 `851tegakizatsu` 89 - 使用 `theme.stylize` 选择内置风格并传参 90 - `rough`：手绘效果 91 - `pattern`：图案填充 92 - `linear-gradient` / `radial-gradient`：渐变风格 93 - 仅输出 Infographic 语法本身，不输出 JSON、解释性文字或额外 Markdown 段落 94 95 ## 数据语法示例 96 97 按模板类别给出精简但完整的正向示例： 98 99 - `list-*` 模板 100 101 ```infographic 102 infographic list-grid-badge-card 103 data 104 title Feature List 105 lists 106 - label Fast 107 icon flash fast 108 - label Secure 109 icon shield check 110 ``` 111 112 - `sequence-*` 模板 113 114 ```infographic 115 infographic sequence-ascending-steps 116 data 117 title 发布流程 118 sequences 119 - label 需求确认 120 - label 开发实现 121 - label 发布上线 122 order asc 123 ``` 124 125 - `sequence-interaction-*` 模板 126 127 ```infographic 128 infographic sequence-interaction-compact-animated-badge-card 129 data 130 title 登录校验流程 131 sequences 132 - label 用户 133 children 134 - label 发起登录 135 id user-login 136 step 0 137 - label 收到结果 138 id user-result 139 step 2 140 - label 服务端 141 children 142 - label 校验凭证 143 id server-verify 144 step 1 145 - label 返回结果 146 id server-return 147 step 2 148 relations 149 user-login - 提交账号密码 -> server-verify 150 server-verify - 生成结果 -> server-return 151 server-return - 返回结果 -> user-result 152 ``` 153 154 - `hierarchy-*` 模板 155 156 ```infographic 157 infographic hierarchy-tree-curved-line-rounded-rect-node 158 data 159 title 组织结构 160 root 161 label 公司 162 children 163 - label 产品部 164 - label 技术部 165 ``` 166 167 - `compare-swot` 模板 168 169 ```infographic 170 infographic compare-swot 171 data 172 title 产品 SWOT 173 compares 174 - label Strengths 175 children 176 - label 品牌认知高 177 - label Weaknesses 178 children 179 - label 成本压力大 180 ``` 181 182 - `compare-binary-*` 模板 183 184 ```infographic 185 infographic compare-binary-horizontal-simple-fold 186 data 187 title 餐桌价格对比 188 compares 189 - label 原价 190 children 191 - label 原价 192 value 500 193 icon tag 194 - label 实际支付 195 children 196 - label 实际支付 197 value 450 198 icon check bold 199 ``` 200 201 - `compare-quadrant-*` 模板 202 203 ```infographic 204 infographic compare-quadrant-quarter-simple-card 205 data 206 title 任务优先级 207 compares 208 - label 高价值低成本 209 - label 高价值高成本 210 - label 低价值低成本 211 - label 低价值高成本 212 ``` 213 214 - `chart-line-plain-text` 模板 215 216 ```infographic 217 infographic chart-line-plain-text 218 data 219 title 模型 A 准确率变化 220 desc 第 4 周提升最明显 221 values 222 - label Week1 223 value 86.5 224 - label Week2 225 value 87.3 226 - label Week3 227 value 89.1 228 - label Week4 229 value 91.2 230 theme 231 palette #4f46e5 #db2777 #14b8a6 232 ``` 233 234 - `relation-*` 模板 235 236 ```infographic 237 infographic relation-dagre-flow-tb-simple-circle-node 238 data 239 title 系统关系 240 nodes 241 - label API 242 - id db 243 label DB 244 relations 245 API - 读写 -> db 246 ``` 247 248 - 兜底 `items` 示例 249 250 ```infographic 251 infographic list-row-horizontal-icon-arrow 252 data 253 title 要点总结 254 items 255 - label 效率优先 256 desc 聚焦关键动作 257 - label 结果导向 258 desc 输出可执行结论 259 ``` 260 261 ### 可用模板 262 263 - chart-bar-plain-text 264 - chart-column-simple 265 - chart-line-plain-text 266 - chart-pie-compact-card 267 - 严格顺序、步骤推进、阶段演进 → `sequence-*` 332 - 多角色或多系统交互 → `sequence-interaction-*` 333 - 并列要点列举 → `list-row-*` / `list-column-*` / `list-grid-*` 334 - 双方对比、方案对比、前后对比 → `compare-binary-*` 335 - 先确定双方是谁 336 - 再为双方分别展开 `children` 337 - 1	# Bot Mitigation at Scale: Protecting Scientific Publishing Platforms
     2	
     3	## Background and Motivation
     4	
     5	Major scientific publishing platforms such as www.science.org — the digital home of the journal *Science* published by AAAS — serve millions of researchers, educators, and policymakers worldwide. These platforms host high-value intellectual property including peer-reviewed articles, supplementary datasets, and digital object identifiers (DOIs) such as `10.1126/science.add1585`. The combination of valuable content and high traffic volumes makes them prime targets for automated bot activity, including large-scale scraping, credential stuffing, and denial-of-service attacks.
     6	
     7	According to industry analyses, approximately **47% of all internet traffic** in 2024 originated from bots, with roughly **30% classified as malicious**. Academic publishers face a disproportionate share of scraping bots that attempt to harvest full-text articles at scale.
     8	
     9	## Challenge-Based Verification Pipeline
    10	
    11	To counter these threats, platforms like www.science.org employ CDN-level security services (e.g., Cloudflare) that intercept incoming requests and apply a multi-stage verification pipeline before granting access to content.
    12	
    13	| Stage | Action | Typical Duration |
    14	|-------|--------|------------------|
    15	| 1. Request Interception | Incoming HTTP request is routed through the CDN edge node | <50 ms |
    16	| 2. Threat Scoring | IP reputation, TLS fingerprint, and behavioral signals are evaluated | ~100 ms |
    17	| 3. Challenge Issuance | If risk score exceeds threshold, a JavaScript or CAPTCHA challenge is served | ~500 ms |
    18	| 4. Verification Check | Client response is validated; a unique Ray ID (e.g., `9edb9b44499904f9`) is assigned for tracing | ~200 ms |
    19	| 5. Access Grant | Verified user is forwarded to the origin server with a session token | <50 ms |
    20	
    21	The total latency for a legitimate human user completing this pipeline is typically **under 2 seconds**, while automated scripts lacking JavaScript execution capabilities are blocked entirely.
    22	
    23	## Performance and Security Outcomes
    24	
    25	Deployment of CDN-based bot mitigation on academic publishing platforms has yielded significant measurable benefits:
    26	
    27	- **85% reduction** in unauthorized bulk scraping attempts within the first 6 months of deployment.
    28	- Platform uptime maintained at **99.97%** even during bot surge events exceeding 10× normal traffic.
    29	- Fewer than **0.3%** of legitimate users reported access friction attributable to the verification layer.
    30	- Average page-load overhead for verified sessions: **< 150 ms** added latency.
    31	
    32	| Metric | Before Mitigation | After Mitigation |
    33	|--------|-------------------|------------------|
    34	| Scraping attempts per day | ~1.2 million | ~180,000 |
    35	| Avg. origin server load (CPU %) | 78% | 42% |
    36	| Legitimate user complaints (monthly) | 1,200 | 340 |
    37	| Uptime during bot surges | 98.5% | 99.97% |
    38	
    39	## Usability vs. Security Trade-offs
    40	
    41	While security verification is essential, it introduces friction for legitimate users. Key considerations include:
    42	
    43	- **Accessibility**: Challenge pages must comply with WCAG 2.1 standards to avoid excluding users with disabilities.
    44	- **Institutional access**: University IP ranges can be allowlisted to reduce unnecessary challenges for campus users.
    45	- **Transparency**: Clear messaging (e.g., "Performing security verification… Waiting for www.science.org to respond") helps users understand the brief delay.
    46	- **Privacy**: Security services must balance threat detection with user privacy, disclosing data practices clearly.
    47	
    48	## Key Takeaways
    49	
    50	1. Bot traffic represents nearly half of all requests to academic publisher websites.
    51	2. Multi-stage, CDN-edge verification pipelines can block the vast majority of malicious bots with minimal impact on human users.
    52	3. Quantitative monitoring — using traceable identifiers like Ray IDs — enables continuous optimization of the security-usability balance.
    53	4. Collaboration between publishers and CDN providers is critical for sustaining open, secure access to scientific knowledge.

            device_scale_factor=2,
        )
        page = await context.new_page()
        await page.goto("file:///app/output/poster.html")
        # Wait for fonts and infographic rendering
        await page.wait_for_timeout(4000)
        poster = await page.query_selector("#poster")
        if not poster:
            raise RuntimeError("#poster element not found")

            path="/app/output/final_poster.png",
            type="png",
        )
        await browser.close()
        print("Saved /app/output/final_poster.png")
